summary: Pass B review of the AI-agent issue intake. Round1 did not produce this file (missing entirely). This run found one verified blocker: the shipped intake files still enforce ADR-0014's old 'no path text' redaction rule, which r3 Q18 explicitly overrode (owner rule: maximum debug data, only secrets stripped). ADR-0014 itself (the doc under review) states the Q18 text and says the intake files 'must match this rule' -- they do not.

findings.claim: The agent-facing intake files tell the filing agent to withhold paths, logs, transcripts and command output, contradicting the settled r3 decision Q18 that requires maximum debug data with only secrets stripped.
file_evidence: docs/v2/review/agent-issue-intake/DO-NOT-SEND.md lines 9-19: bans 'A file path, home directory, or project directory name', 'Raw command output, a stack trace, or a log excerpt', full command lines with arguments.

docs/v2/review/agent-issue-intake/AGENT_ISSUE.md (root draft) section 3 'What you leave out': bans 'agent debug logs, transcripts, session files, stack traces', 'file contents, command output, ctx_search or ctx_execute results', 'absolute paths, user names, host names, repo names'.

docs/v2/adr/0014-issue-forms-and-debug-report.md line 81-83 (the r3 Q18 decision, recorded inside ADR-0014 itself): 'The reporter is an AI agent (owner rule). It must send: the full ctx_doctor report, paths, logs, versions, hook and deny journal rows, the steps, and transcript excerpts of the failing turns. Only secrets are removed... This replaces ADR-0014's no path text rule... the intake files... must match this rule.'

docs/v2/review/DECISIONS-r3.md line 24, Q18: 'Issue debug data: only secrets are stripped (tokens, .env values). Paths, logs, versions, transcript excerpts and the doctor report are required. This replaces ADR-0014's no path text rule (owner rule: maximum debug data).'
findings.fix: Rewrite DO-NOT-SEND.md and the 'What you leave out' section of AGENT_ISSUE.md to the Q18 list: strip only tokens/keys/.env values/Authorization headers; explicitly allow and request paths, logs, hook/deny journal rows, and transcript excerpts of the failing turns. Update bug.yml's markdown intro line ('Do not send settings, .env or MCP config files, logs, transcripts, file contents, paths, tokens or the user's own prompts') the same way -- it currently also forbids logs/transcripts/paths, which is the same Q18 violation on the web form side.

findings.claim: Round1 of this review role never ran: out/r4/B/round1/review/agent-issue-intake.json does not exist, so no prior pass checked the intake docs against Q18 or against the owner's 'AI agents only, enforce rules, max debug data' instruction before this round2 pass.
file_evidence: Task instructions state: 'No review/agent-issue-intake.json file exists in out/r4/B/round1 at all. This role did not run.'
findings.fix: Treat this round2 output as the first full pass for this role; do not assume AII topics were covered by earlier rX syntheses unless explicitly cited (none were found referencing agent-issue-intake by name in REVIEW-r4a.md search).

findings.claim: ADR-0014 status is still 'Proposed', not 'Accepted', while bug.yml, AGENT_ISSUE.md and the issue-intake workflow are already written and wired as if the ADR were final. The root README.md for this folder itself flags this as an open item ('ADR-0014 is status Proposed, not yet Accepted -- confirm acceptance before wiring this in.').
file_evidence: docs/v2/review/agent-issue-intake/README.md (draft) 'Open items' section lists the same gap.
findings.fix: Get an explicit owner accept on ADR-0014 (including the Q18 amendment text) before merging the GitHub Action and templates to the default branch, since they encode behaviour (what agents must send) that is still only 'Proposed'.

findings.claim: issue-intake.yml target: GitHub only runs 'issues:' workflows from the DEFAULT branch (main). The repo's main is frozen on v1 (owner decision). The committed workflow comment itself says 'Must live on the DEFAULT branch', so merging this intake system requires a change to the frozen main branch, which is a cross-cutting conflict not resolved anywhere in the docs reviewed.
file_evidence: .github/workflows/issue-intake.yml line 1 comment: '# Must live on the DEFAULT branch: GitHub runs issues workflows only from there.'
Owner decision (task preamble): 'main frozen on v1'.
findings.fix: Add an explicit carve-out to the 'main frozen' rule for non-code, issue-automation-only files (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, .github/workflows/issue-intake.yml, .github/scripts/issue-intake*.mjs), or document how the intake system takes effect without touching main.

notes: Issue template (bug.yml) itself is correctly targeted at AI agents (explicit 'Coding agent: read .github/AGENT_ISSUE.md' instruction, dropdown Report status, required ctx-report textarea, checkboxes enforcing search-before-file and user-consent) and the issue-intake.yml + issue-intake.mjs + issue-intake-act.mjs correctly validate structurally (heading parse, no regex, digest recompute) and comment with a fix command -- these parts match the owner rule on form and enforcement. The one real defect is content: the redaction instructions baked into DO-NOT-SEND.md / AGENT_ISSUE.md / bug.yml's intro text were written to the pre-Q18 ADR-0014 rule and were never updated after Q18 loosened it.
